findings.motion: Senate passage of Sen. Larry Walker III's absentee voter ID bill, 35-18
findings.note: News report (Augusta Press, published 2021-02-25; floor action on Tuesday, photo caption dates the Senate floor debate Feb. 23, 2021) says he voted in favour. The bill would require absentee voters to give a driver's licence or state ID number, or photocopies of a passport, employee ID card, utility bill or bank statement. Bill number is not on the page; the official roll call was not read.
